# Odette Pullen

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c6 P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c6 P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 c6 P12](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

Odette Pullen is a young girl from Brierley.

_Sources: [v1 c6 P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 c6 P12](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0012), [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068)_

## Personality

Odette is helpful, obedient, and enthusiastic about adventures.

_Sources: [v1 c6 P12](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0012), [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068)_

## History

Odette Pullen resides in Brierley. Her father, Robert, miscommunicated a message sent by Obed and Thirza Abernethy regarding the adoption of an orphan boy, causing her aunt, Mrs. Alexander Tranter, to bring back a girl instead. When Thirza Abernethy and Nell visited Mrs. Tranter at Pale Sands Cove, Odette helped welcome the guests and prepared tea in the kitchen. Later, she attended a Sunday-school picnic at Lake of Glassy Waters, where she nearly fell into the water while reaching for water lilies before her father caught her.

_Sources: [v1 c6 P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 c6 P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 c6 P5](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0005), [v1 c6 P12](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0012), [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068)_
